class.name: OcgGraphic3dTextureroot
class.brief_description: This is the texture root class enable the dialog with the GraphicDriver allows the loading of texture.
class.description: ! This is the texture root class enable the dialog with the GraphicDriver allows the loading of ! texture.

method.name: IsDone
method.description: Checks if a texture class is valid or not.

method.name: UpdateRevision
method.description: Update image revision. Can be used for signaling changes in the texture source (e.g. file update, pixmap update) without re-creating texture source itself (since unique id should be never modified).

method.name: GetCompressedImage
method.description: This method will be called by graphic driver each time when texture resource should be created. It is called in front of GetImage() for uploading compressed image formats natively supported by GPU.

method.name: IsColorMap
method.description: Return flag indicating color nature of values within the texture; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetColorMap
method.description: Set flag indicating color nature of values within the texture.

method.name: HasMipmaps
method.description: Returns whether mipmaps should be generated or not.

method.name: SetMipmapsGeneration
method.description: Sets whether to generate mipmaps or not.

method.name: IsTopDown
method.description: Returns whether row's memory layout is top-down.
